item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single 2024 manifesto, doctrine paper, or one speech that laid out a fully integrated governing ideology end to end. What exists instead is a revealed program spread across repeated speeches and policy moves, mostly in education, macro reform, anti-theft enforcement, and social protection.
